title: Random forest on an eight-protein signature diagnoses tuberculosis
summary: Across 630 prospectively enrolled subjects, two rounds of screening identified an eight-protein TB biosignature (I-TAC, I-309, MIG, Granulysin, FAP, MEP1B, Furin, LYVE-1). A random forest gave 100% sensitivity and specificity in the training cohort by cross-validation, 76% sensitivity and 83% specificity in the test cohort (n=92), and 75% and 84% in the prediction cohort (n=102). Performance outside training is moderate.
ai_technology: Random forest classifier on an eight-protein biosignature selected from a 640-protein antibody array

evidence.tested: Test cohort (n=92) and prediction cohort (n=102) sensitivity 76% and 75%, specificity 83% and 84%.
evidence.unknown: Performance in other settings; full text not reviewed.
